fields.Name: Skip ICF - Cheese Competition Results
fields.Description: Competition entries by category with medal counts -> entries by year -> entrants. Uses MoreCheese: Competition Entries.

InputDefinition.userMessage: Show me our cheese competition results: for each competition category, how many entries and how many gold, silver and bronze medals, as a grouped or stacked bar chart. Let me click a category to see entries and medal rate by year, and then click a year to see the individual entries with the cheese name, entrant, organization and result. [NO CHAT]

judgeValidationCriteria: Response includes a chart by competition category with entries and gold/silver/bronze counts
Uses MoreCheese: Competition Entries (Category, EntryYear, Result, ProductName)
Six categories appear; Alpine Styles has the most entries (about 87); about 423 entries in total, most with no medal
Clicking a category shows entries and medal rate by year
Clicking a year shows individual entries with cheese name, entrant, organization and result
Rows can open the competition entry or person record
